inspection_basis: The inspections and retrievals recorded here occurred during the accepted source-credit audit. Edition preparation preserves their findings and verifies document identities; it does not claim fresh source retrieval or inspection.
review_status: This is an independent internal AI source-credit and mathematical audit, with an AI-assisted reconstruction of the published proof. The reconstruction and audit are unrefereed; no external human peer review, journal acceptance of this audit, or formal proof-assistant certification is claimed.

inspection_limits.scope: full selected original contribution and complete relevant theorem proof; not every page of all cited books/papers
not_relied_on: An initial guessed EMS article URL led to an unrelated paper; its content was discarded. Correct MOS URL was found through primary publisher search.
Search snippets and unrelated search results are not proof evidence.
inspection_limits.dependency_limit: Characteristic-zero proof chain accepted. Positive-characteristic extensions of cited HR/BD statements not independently certified.

visual_cross_checks.description: Text extraction was cross-checked on the original target, field, theorem, normalization and convention pages. This is selected-page inspection, not inspection of every page of every cited paper.
